rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: APKTool-MCP Server provides a bridge to the APKTool utility, enabling AI assistants to analyze and modify Android application packages. This Python implementation offers tools for decoding APKs, examining and editing smali code, managing resources, searching through project files, and rebuilding modified applications. The server includes functionality for extracting DEX files, analyzing permissions, signing APKs, and installing them on connected devices, making it particularly valuable for Android application reverse engineering, security analysis, and customization tasks.
